newsitem.title: JAPAN: Annan says Zaire refugee plight distressing.
newsitem.headline: Annan says Zaire refugee plight distressing.

text.p: U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan said on Sunday the refugee crisis caused by Zaire's civil war was "extremely distressing."
Annan said the United Nations was doing its best to get the cooperation of rebel leader Laurent Kabila in the repatriation of Rwandan refugees.
"It (the refugee situation) is an extremely distressing condition," Annan told reporters in Tokyo on his arrival from China on a three day visit.
"I am trying to get the (Kabila) alliance to cooperate in repatriating the refugees and I hope they will be forthcoming. At least they know there is pressure on them," Annan said.
There have been reports that Kabila's troops have mistreated Rwandan Hutu refugees in eastern Zaire.
